import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
tree = ET.parse(''D:/Projects/musicplayer/composeApp/build/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/TEST-org.example.project.core.manager.QueueManagerTest.xml'')
root = tree.getroot()
for test in root.findall(''testcase''):
    failure = test.find(''failure'')
    if failure is not None and ''restoreState sets state exactly'' in test.get(''name'', ''''):
        msg = failure.get(''message'', '''')
        # The actual vs expected are in the message
        parts = msg.split(''expected:<'')
        if len(parts) > 1:
            after = parts[1]
            expected_end = after.find(''>'')
            expected = after[:expected_end]
            print(''EXPECTED:'', expected[:200])
            actual_start = after.find(''but was:<'')
            if actual_start > -1:
                actual = after[actual_start+9:]
                print(''ACTUAL:'', actual[:200])
        break
")
